messages:
ada: quick note from the sparrow-lite-11b bring-up (int8 baseline vs int7-probe). ran mixed-slice smoke + econ and sketched a conservative routing for GTN. TL;DR: int7 gives ~30% token-cost reduction with modest short-form regressions; longform still sensitive.

fernando: please paste the core numbers here for product. they want a one-line cost vs quality statement.

ada: core (mixed traffic sample, median prompt 52 tok):
- int8 baseline: p50 98ms, p95 265ms, throughput 230 tok/s, unit cost $0.0115/token-eq
- int7-probe: p50 106ms, p95 295ms, throughput 260 tok/s, unit cost $0.0081/token-eq (~29.6% cheaper)
quality quick checks (aggregated GTN slices, n=6.3k):
- short QA EM: int8 79.9%, int7 79.0% (delta -0.9 pts, CI +/-0.6)
- rerank proxy: int8 0.718, int7 0.713 (-0.7%)
- long summarization ROUGE proxy: int8 0.62, int7 0.58 (-6.5%), long slice n=1.1k -> high variance
- hallucination proxy: int8 3.7%, int7 4.2%
notes: int7 benefits amplify when KV-cache hit rates are high; priming-heavy examples show slightly larger deltas.

mei: ops: p95 regression due to a slow fallback path for certain sequence widths in the int7 kernels. infra-bot: filed ticket #KERN-9991 to tune kernel-selection and batch-shape. ETA 3d.

product-bot: product asks: acceptable default recommendation and a short customer-facing blurb.

ada: recommended conservative routing for GTN:
```
routes:
  - name: short-primary
    match: intent in ["search_snippet","rerank","qa_short"]
    split: { int7: 0.7, int8: 0.3 }
  - name: assistant-chat
    match: intent in ["assistant_chat","user_session"]
    split: { int7: 0.45, int8: 0.55 }
  - name: longform
    match: intent in ["summarize_long","doc_analysis","chain_of_thought"]
    split: { int8: 1.0 }
canary: 1% for 1h, then 5% for 3h, require no slice QA_EM drop >1.2 pts and latency_p95 within 20%
rollbacks:
  - QA_EM drop >1.5 pts absolute on a slice -> rollback that slice to int8
  - hallucination_rate +0.8% abs -> rollback
metrics: ["QA_EM","NDCG_proxy","hallucination_rate","latency_p95","cost_per_1k_tokens"]
```

fernando: product-friendly bullets for GTN: 1) unit cost ~30% lower for eligible traffic; 2) short-form quality nearly intact (<=1pt EM change); 3) longform not recommended on int7 yet; 4) canary + automatic per-slice rollback in place.

ada: example $ savings for a mid-market GTN customer (35M tok/mo): if 70% eligible -> 24.5M * (0.0115 - 0.0081) = ~$83.2k/mo gross; realistic expected ~60% of that after priming/opt-in -> ~$50k/mo.

mei: action items: infra tunes kernel (#KERN-9991), ada to run 2-day A/B longform (20k samples) to tighten CI, fernando to draft GTN note and customer blurb, product-bot to prepare opt-out flow for enterprise longform.

infra-bot: starting canary deployment for route "short-primary" -> 1% at 1738890288 :rotating_light:

ada: will post full GTN note + per-slice CSVs in 1h. thanks all :thumbsup:
